title: Telco Customer Churn
description: Customer churn prediction dataset for a telecommunications provider. Predicts whether a customer will churn based on service usage and account features.
short_narrative: This dataset supports a binary classification model that predicts customer churn for a telecommunications provider. Given a customer's service usage, contract type, and account features, the model estimates the likelihood that the customer will cancel their subscription.
long_narrative: The Telco Customer Churn dataset is used to train and evaluate a binary classification model that identifies customers at risk of churning. Churn prediction is a core operational task for telecommunications providers: retaining an existing customer is significantly less costly than acquiring a new one. The model takes as input a range of account and service-level features — including contract type, tenure, monthly charges, and service subscriptions — and outputs a probability score indicating churn likelihood. The dataset reflects real-world class imbalance: churn events are less frequent than non-churn events, which the model accounts for during training.
